question: How can the varied levels of manifestation be contained within consciousness?
premises: Some śālagrāma stones naturally contain varied forms within themselves.
Consciousness has a variegated inner nature.
The inner delineations of the levels from māyā downward are contained within consciousness.
inference: The manifold levels of manifestation are inner differentiations within consciousness, not external additions to it.
plain_english: Just as some śālagrāma stones contain varied forms within them, so the inner delineations of the levels from māyā downward belong to the variegated heart of consciousness.
